note: Which cards form one picture together, and in what order. Order is load-bearing: a panorama assembled wrongly renders as visibly broken art. COMBINED_ILLUSTRATION is one image split across cards. NARRATIVE_SEQUENCE is a story continued across cards - a different thing, and conflating the two produces wrong captions. SHARED_BACKGROUND_PATTERN is neither: only a background element continues.

whyPartial.lostToAbsentEnglishSetsNote: English sets we have simply never ingested - Furious Fists 35, Skyridge 25, Southern Islands 18, Fusion Strike 13, Legendary Treasures 12, Fates Collide 11, Platinum: Arceus 11. All available from pokemontcg.io and all inside the English-only policy.
whyPartial.lostToJapaneseOnlyPrintingsNote: Japanese promo printings - MEP Promo, T Promo, P Promo, SM-P Promo, PokePark Forest, Vending. ENGLISH-ONLY is a locked Tyler directive in CLAUDE.md, so these are a policy limit and not an engineering task. They change only if he rules otherwise.
